gaps.note: the rest of the kit (the top cross bracket with the rear and front skirts, the intumescent panel, the 23 in. rack adapter brackets and the screws) is not seen from the front of the rack and is not modelled.

gaps.wanted: no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

model: 7360 ISAM FX-8 vertical shelf mount kit, top baffle

chassis.note: Nokia 7360 ISAM FX-8 Vertical shelf mount kit unit data sheet (3FE 67300 BAAA TQZZA Edition 01), Table 5: the baffle is 99.74 mm high, 205.74 mm wide and 381 mm long. Read as height up the rack, depth, and width across it, which Figure 84 of the 7360 ISAM FX ANSI Hardware Installation Manual (3HH-12893-AAAA-TCZZA Issue 29) supports: the baffle spans about the width of the shelf with its ring-guides along its face.

color.note: the held figures are line art and no photograph is held, so the colour is a neutral metal grey and is not a reading. The ring-guides the unit data sheet says the baffle carries are not drawn: no figure held dimensions them.

ears.note: no ears. Figure 84 of the installation manual (printed page 168) draws the baffle as a plain box standing on the shelf's bracket between the posts, with no ear, flange or bolt to a post. The brackets with bolts at the posts are the shelf's, under the baffle.

units.note: two rack units, read from Figure 84 of the installation manual, where the next shelf's tray stands 15 units above the one under the first, which with a tray of two units and a shelf that takes eleven leaves two for the baffle. The baffle is 99.74 mm, 2.24 units, so it stands about 5.4 mm proud of its units at each end, where the shelf's own spare height (eleven units are 488.95 mm, the shelf 446.5 mm) lies. No table prints the units.
